name: Barbell Bench Press
setup: Lie on a flat bench with eyes under the bar. Plant feet firmly. Grip slightly wider than shoulder width and unrack with straight wrists.
form_cues: Pull shoulder blades down and back. Keep a small natural arch. Lower the bar to the lower chest. Keep forearms near vertical. Press up and slightly back without bouncing.

name: Dumbbell Bench Press
setup: Sit with dumbbells on thighs, then kick them into position as you lie back.
form_cues: Keep shoulder blades retracted. Lower until elbows are slightly below the torso if comfortable. Keep wrists stacked over elbows. Press without clanking the dumbbells together.

name: Incline Barbell Bench Press
setup: Set bench to roughly 20 to 35 degrees. Position eyes under the bar and plant feet.
form_cues: Keep shoulder blades pinned back. Lower bar to upper chest. Avoid flaring elbows straight out. Press up while maintaining contact with the bench.

name: Incline Dumbbell Press
setup: Set bench to roughly 20 to 35 degrees. Bring dumbbells to shoulder level.
form_cues: Use a controlled descent. Keep elbows slightly tucked. Press the dumbbells up over the upper chest rather than toward the face.

name: Decline Barbell Bench Press
setup: Secure legs in the decline bench and position the bar over the lower chest.
form_cues: Keep shoulders retracted. Lower under control to the lower chest or upper abdomen. Press without bouncing.

name: Decline Dumbbell Press
setup: Secure legs before bringing dumbbells into position.
form_cues: Lower with control and keep wrists stacked. Press upward while keeping the ribcage controlled.

name: Machine Chest Press
setup: Adjust seat so handles line up around mid chest. Set the back pad so shoulder blades remain supported.
form_cues: Keep wrists neutral. Press smoothly without locking out aggressively. Do not let shoulders roll forward at the bottom.

name: Smith Machine Bench Press
setup: Position bench so the fixed bar path reaches the lower to mid chest.
form_cues: Retract shoulders and keep feet planted. Lower with control. Avoid forcing an uncomfortable bar path.

name: Push-Up
setup: Start in a high plank with hands just outside shoulder width.
form_cues: Keep body in a straight line. Lower chest between the hands. Keep elbows about 30 to 60 degrees from the torso. Push the floor away.

name: Wide Push-Up
setup: Place hands wider than normal push-up width.
form_cues: Keep ribs and hips aligned. Do not let elbows flare excessively. Lower with control and press through the palms.

name: Diamond Push-Up
setup: Place hands close together under the sternum, forming a narrow base.
form_cues: Keep elbows close to the torso. Maintain a rigid plank. Stop if wrist discomfort develops.

name: Decline Push-Up
setup: Place feet on an elevated stable surface and hands on the floor.
form_cues: Keep hips from sagging. Lower chest toward the floor. Maintain a neutral neck and press evenly.

name: Incline Push-Up
setup: Place hands on a stable elevated surface and feet on the floor.
form_cues: Maintain a straight body line. Lower chest toward the edge of the surface and press away.

name: Weighted Push-Up
setup: Use a snug weight vest or have a partner place a plate high on the back, not the lower spine.
form_cues: Use standard push-up mechanics. Keep the added load secure and avoid excessive lumbar extension.

name: Archer Push-Up
setup: Use a very wide hand position. Shift most of your bodyweight toward one arm while the other arm stays more extended.
form_cues: Keep the working elbow tracking naturally. Move side to side under control. Do not twist the hips.

name: Chest Dip
setup: Support yourself on parallel bars and lean the torso slightly forward.
form_cues: Lower only as far as the shoulders tolerate. Keep shoulders down away from ears. Press through the bars without swinging.

name: Pec Deck Fly
setup: Adjust seat so elbows or handles align with mid chest.
form_cues: Keep a slight elbow bend. Bring arms together by squeezing the chest. Do not let shoulders roll forward aggressively.

name: Cable Fly
setup: Set pulleys around chest height and step forward into a split stance.
form_cues: Keep elbows softly bent. Bring hands together in an arc. Keep shoulders down and control the stretch.

name: Low-to-High Cable Fly
setup: Set pulleys low and stand slightly forward of the stacks.
form_cues: Sweep hands upward and inward toward upper chest or chin level. Keep ribs down and avoid shrugging.

name: High-to-Low Cable Fly
setup: Set pulleys above shoulder height.
form_cues: Sweep hands down and inward toward the lower chest or upper abdomen. Keep elbows softly bent and torso stable.

name: Resistance Band Chest Press
setup: Anchor band securely behind you at chest height.
form_cues: Press straight forward while keeping ribs stacked. Return slowly and keep the band under control.

name: Resistance Band Fly
setup: Anchor the band behind you around chest height.
form_cues: With soft elbows, bring arms together in front of the chest. Do not over-stretch the shoulders behind the body.

name: Svend Press
setup: Hold one or two plates squeezed together in front of the chest.
form_cues: Maintain inward pressure on the plates while pressing forward. Keep shoulders down and ribs controlled.

name: Dumbbell Pullover
setup: Lie across or along a bench and hold one dumbbell above the chest with both hands.
form_cues: Keep elbows slightly bent. Lower behind the head only as far as shoulder mobility allows. Pull back over the chest without overextending the spine.

name: Conventional Deadlift
setup: Stand with midfoot under the bar. Grip just outside the legs. Bring shins to the bar while keeping the bar over midfoot.
form_cues: Brace hard. Keep the bar close. Push the floor away and stand tall. Do not yank the bar or overlean backward at lockout.

name: Sumo Deadlift
setup: Take a wide stance with toes turned out. Grip the bar inside the knees.
form_cues: Brace and wedge hips close to the bar. Push knees out in line with toes. Keep the bar close and lock out by standing tall.

name: Romanian Deadlift
setup: Start standing with the bar at hip height.
form_cues: Push hips back with soft knees. Keep the bar close to the legs. Stop when hamstrings are deeply stretched without rounding the back. Drive hips forward to stand.

name: Barbell Bent-Over Row
setup: Hinge at the hips until torso is roughly 30 to 60 degrees from horizontal.
form_cues: Brace the trunk. Row bar toward lower ribs or upper abdomen. Keep elbows controlled and avoid jerking the torso.

name: Pendlay Row
setup: Set the bar on the floor and hinge until the torso is close to parallel.
form_cues: Brace before each rep. Pull explosively to lower chest or upper abdomen, then return the bar to the floor without bouncing.

name: One-Arm Dumbbell Row
setup: Support one hand and knee or one hand on a bench. Keep the working foot planted.
form_cues: Row the dumbbell toward the hip. Keep shoulders square and avoid twisting the torso.

name: Chest-Supported Dumbbell Row
setup: Lie chest-down on an incline bench with dumbbells hanging beneath you.
form_cues: Pull elbows back and slightly out based on target. Keep chest on the pad and avoid shrugging.

name: Seated Cable Row
setup: Sit tall with knees slightly bent and handle attached to low cable.
form_cues: Pull handle toward lower ribs. Keep torso mostly still. Do not over-reach by rounding the low back.

name: T-Bar Row
setup: Straddle the bar or use a chest-supported T-bar machine. Hinge if unsupported.
form_cues: Row toward the chest or upper abdomen. Keep elbows controlled and spine neutral.

name: Landmine Row
setup: Anchor one end of a barbell. Straddle the bar and use a V-handle or grasp the bar sleeve.
form_cues: Hinge and brace. Pull toward the lower chest. Keep the bar close and avoid excessive torso movement.

name: Lat Pulldown
setup: Adjust thigh pad snugly and grip the bar slightly wider than shoulders.
form_cues: Pull elbows down toward the ribs. Bring bar toward upper chest. Avoid leaning far back or pulling behind the neck.

name: Close-Grip Lat Pulldown
setup: Attach a close neutral or underhand handle and secure thighs.
form_cues: Pull handle toward upper chest while driving elbows down. Control the stretch overhead.

name: Single-Arm Lat Pulldown
setup: Use a high cable and kneel or sit so the arm starts overhead.
form_cues: Drive elbow toward the hip. Keep torso from rotating and avoid shrugging.

name: Straight-Arm Pulldown
setup: Set cable high and stand far enough back for tension at the top.
form_cues: Keep elbows nearly straight. Pull from overhead down toward thighs by using the lats. Avoid turning it into a triceps pressdown.

name: Pull-Up
setup: Hang from a bar with hands slightly wider than shoulders.
form_cues: Start by pulling shoulders down. Drive elbows toward the ribs. Bring upper chest toward the bar without swinging.

name: Chin-Up
setup: Use a shoulder-width underhand grip.
form_cues: Keep ribs controlled. Pull chest upward while driving elbows down. Lower to full control.

name: Neutral-Grip Pull-Up
setup: Grip parallel handles and begin from a controlled hang.
form_cues: Pull shoulders down and elbows toward the sides. Avoid kicking or excessive arching.

name: Assisted Pull-Up
equipment: Assisted pull-up machine or resistance band
setup: Use a machine counterweight or a safely secured band.
form_cues: Use the same mechanics as a normal pull-up. Avoid relying on momentum.

name: Inverted Row
equipment: Bar in rack or suspension trainer
setup: Set a bar around waist height and hang beneath it with body straight.
form_cues: Pull chest to the bar while squeezing shoulder blades. Keep hips from sagging.

name: Face Pull
setup: Set cable around face height and grip rope with thumbs pointing back.
form_cues: Pull rope toward forehead while rotating hands apart. Keep shoulders down and avoid arching the low back.

name: Barbell Shrug
setup: Hold bar at thigh level with arms straight.
form_cues: Elevate shoulders straight up toward ears. Pause briefly. Do not roll the shoulders.

name: Dumbbell Shrug
setup: Hold dumbbells at sides with neutral grip.
form_cues: Shrug straight upward and control the lowering phase. Avoid bending elbows.

name: Back Extension
setup: Set pad just below the hip crease so hips can hinge freely.
form_cues: Hinge at the hips, not through the low back. Rise until body forms a straight line. Do not hyperextend.

name: Reverse Hyperextension
equipment: Reverse hyper machine or sturdy bench
setup: Position hips at the edge of the pad with legs hanging.
form_cues: Raise legs by extending the hips. Stop around body alignment and avoid throwing the legs upward.

name: Good Morning
setup: Place bar securely across upper back as for a squat. Use a moderate stance.
form_cues: Brace and push hips back with soft knees. Keep spine neutral. Return by driving hips forward.

name: Superman Hold
setup: Lie face down with arms overhead or by the sides.
form_cues: Lift chest and legs slightly while keeping neck neutral. Use a modest range and avoid forcing lumbar extension.

name: Barbell Overhead Press
setup: Start with bar at upper chest, wrists stacked, and feet about hip to shoulder width.
form_cues: Brace glutes and abs. Move head slightly back as bar passes, then bring head through at lockout. Do not lean excessively backward.

name: Dumbbell Shoulder Press
setup: Start dumbbells around shoulder level, seated or standing.
form_cues: Press overhead while keeping ribs down. Keep wrists over elbows and avoid excessive arching.

name: Arnold Press
setup: Start with palms facing you and dumbbells near chin level.
form_cues: Rotate elbows outward as you press overhead. Use a smooth path rather than forcing rotation.

name: Machine Shoulder Press
setup: Adjust seat so handles begin near shoulder height.
form_cues: Press overhead without shrugging excessively. Keep back against pad and control the return.

name: Landmine Press
setup: Hold the end of the bar at shoulder height with one or both hands.
form_cues: Press up and forward along the bar path. Keep ribs stacked and avoid twisting.

name: Dumbbell Lateral Raise
setup: Stand tall with dumbbells at sides and elbows softly bent.
form_cues: Raise arms out to the sides until around shoulder height. Lead with elbows. Avoid swinging or shrugging.

name: Cable Lateral Raise
setup: Set pulley low. Stand side-on or slightly in front of the cable.
form_cues: Raise arm out to the side with a soft elbow. Keep torso still and control the return.

name: Machine Lateral Raise
setup: Adjust seat so machine pivot aligns with shoulder joint.
form_cues: Drive elbows outward into pads. Stop near shoulder height and avoid shrugging.

name: Front Raise
setup: Stand tall with weight in front of thighs.
form_cues: Raise to about shoulder height while keeping ribs down. Avoid using momentum.

name: Rear Delt Fly
setup: Hinge forward or lie chest-supported on an incline bench.
form_cues: Sweep arms outward with soft elbows. Focus on moving from the shoulders and avoid shrugging.

name: Reverse Pec Deck
setup: Adjust seat so handles line up with shoulders.
form_cues: Pull arms apart while keeping chest against pad. Avoid excessive low-back arch.

name: Cable Rear Delt Fly
setup: Cross cable handles in front of you at shoulder height.
form_cues: Pull arms outward with soft elbows. Keep shoulders down and torso still.

name: Upright Row
setup: Use a grip around shoulder width or slightly wider.
form_cues: Pull elbows upward only to a comfortable height. Do not force elbows far above shoulders if it causes impingement.

name: Dumbbell Y-Raise
setup: Use very light weights. Stand hinged or lie chest-down on an incline bench.
form_cues: Raise arms diagonally into a Y. Keep thumbs up and shoulders away from ears.

name: Scaption Raise
setup: Hold light dumbbells with thumbs slightly up.
form_cues: Raise arms about 30 degrees forward from directly out to the sides. Stop near shoulder height.

name: External Rotation Cable
setup: Set cable around elbow height. Keep elbow bent 90 degrees and pinned to side.
form_cues: Rotate forearm outward without letting elbow drift. Use light resistance and controlled motion.

name: Band External Rotation
setup: Anchor band at elbow height. Bend elbow to 90 degrees and keep it close to ribs.
form_cues: Rotate hand outward while upper arm stays still. Move slowly.

name: Wall Slide
setup: Stand with back or forearms against a wall.
form_cues: Slide arms upward while keeping ribs controlled. Reach slightly at the top without shrugging.

name: Barbell Curl
setup: Stand tall with underhand grip around shoulder width.
form_cues: Keep elbows near sides. Curl without swinging the torso. Lower fully under control.

name: EZ-Bar Curl
setup: Grip angled portions of the bar comfortably.
form_cues: Keep wrists neutral and elbows mostly stationary. Avoid leaning back.

name: Dumbbell Curl
setup: Hold dumbbells at sides with palms forward or rotate into supination.
form_cues: Curl while keeping upper arms still. Squeeze at the top and lower slowly.

name: Alternating Dumbbell Curl
setup: Hold one dumbbell in each hand.
form_cues: Curl one side at a time without rotating the torso. Fully control each lowering phase.

name: Hammer Curl
setup: Hold dumbbells with palms facing inward.
form_cues: Curl while keeping neutral grip. Keep elbows near sides and avoid swinging.

name: Incline Dumbbell Curl
setup: Set bench around 45 to 60 degrees and let arms hang behind the torso.
form_cues: Keep shoulders back. Curl without moving elbows forward excessively.

name: Preacher Curl
equipment: Preacher bench, EZ bar or dumbbell
setup: Set upper arms fully on the preacher pad.
form_cues: Curl without lifting upper arms off the pad. Do not slam into full elbow extension at the bottom.

name: Cable Curl
setup: Set pulley low and stand tall.
form_cues: Keep elbows close to sides. Curl smoothly and resist the cable on the way down.

name: Bayesian Cable Curl
setup: Set cable low and stand facing away so the arm starts slightly behind the body.
form_cues: Keep shoulder extended and curl without letting elbow drift forward.

name: Spider Curl
equipment: Dumbbells or EZ bar, incline bench
setup: Lie chest-down on an incline bench with arms hanging.
form_cues: Curl while upper arms stay pointed down. Avoid lifting elbows toward the ceiling.

name: Concentration Curl
setup: Sit and brace the upper arm against the inside of the thigh.
form_cues: Curl slowly and squeeze at the top. Keep the upper arm fixed.

name: Reverse Curl
setup: Use an overhand grip with wrists straight.
form_cues: Curl without letting wrists collapse. Keep elbows near sides.

name: Cable Triceps Pressdown
setup: Set pulley high and stand close to the stack.
form_cues: Pin elbows near sides. Extend forearms downward. Avoid leaning bodyweight onto the handle.

name: Rope Pressdown
setup: Attach rope to high cable.
form_cues: Extend elbows fully while separating rope ends slightly. Keep shoulders stable.

name: Overhead Cable Triceps Extension
setup: Face away from a cable set low or mid height and bring rope behind head.
form_cues: Keep elbows pointing forward. Extend arms without arching the low back.

name: Dumbbell Overhead Triceps Extension
setup: Hold one dumbbell overhead with both hands or one hand.
form_cues: Keep elbows relatively narrow. Lower behind head under control and extend without flaring excessively.

name: Skull Crusher
setup: Lie on bench with arms extended above shoulders.
form_cues: Bend elbows to lower bar toward forehead or slightly behind head. Keep upper arms relatively fixed.

name: Close-Grip Bench Press
setup: Use a grip around shoulder width rather than extremely narrow.
form_cues: Keep wrists stacked. Lower bar to lower chest with elbows tucked moderately. Press without bouncing.

name: Bench Dip
setup: Place hands on a stable bench behind you and feet on the floor.
form_cues: Keep shoulders down and lower only as far as comfortable. Avoid sinking deeply if shoulders feel stressed.

name: Parallel-Bar Dip
setup: Keep torso more upright than a chest-focused dip.
form_cues: Lower with elbows tracking back. Press to lockout while keeping shoulders controlled.

name: Triceps Kickback
setup: Hinge forward and keep upper arm parallel or close to parallel with torso.
form_cues: Extend elbow until arm is straight. Keep upper arm stationary.

name: Single-Arm Cable Pressdown
setup: Set high cable and stand square.
form_cues: Keep elbow by side. Extend smoothly and avoid rotating the torso.

name: Wrist Curl
setup: Rest forearms on thighs or bench with palms up and wrists hanging off edge.
form_cues: Curl only at the wrists. Use controlled range and avoid bouncing.

name: Reverse Wrist Curl
setup: Rest forearms supported with palms down.
form_cues: Extend wrists upward through a comfortable range. Use light weight.

name: Farmer Carry
setup: Pick up weights with a safe deadlift pattern and stand tall.
form_cues: Walk with short controlled steps. Keep ribs stacked and shoulders down. Do not let weights swing.

name: Suitcase Carry
setup: Hold one heavy weight at your side.
form_cues: Walk without leaning toward or away from the weight. Keep torso upright.

name: Plate Pinch Hold
setup: Pinch smooth-sided plates together between fingers and thumb.
form_cues: Stand tall and hold securely. Keep plates away from feet in case grip fails.

name: Dead Hang
setup: Hang from a secure bar with hands around shoulder width.
form_cues: Maintain active shoulder position if passive hanging is uncomfortable. Avoid swinging.

name: Towel Hang
setup: Loop a strong towel over a pull-up bar and grip each end.
form_cues: Hang under control. Keep towel secure and stop before grip fails unexpectedly.

name: Back Squat
setup: Set bar across upper traps or rear delts, brace, and step out into a stable stance.
form_cues: Sit down between the hips while knees track over toes. Keep whole foot planted. Maintain a braced torso and drive up through midfoot.

name: Front Squat
setup: Rack bar on front delts using clean grip or cross-arm grip.
form_cues: Keep elbows high and torso upright. Let knees travel forward naturally. Keep heels planted.

name: Goblet Squat
setup: Hold weight close to chest with both hands.
form_cues: Sit down between knees. Keep chest tall, feet planted, and knees tracking with toes.

name: Hack Squat
setup: Place shoulders and back against pads and feet on platform.
form_cues: Lower under control with knees tracking over toes. Keep hips and back supported. Do not lock knees aggressively.

name: Leg Press
setup: Set feet about shoulder width on platform and adjust seat so lower back stays against pad.
form_cues: Lower until hips remain firmly supported. Press through full foot. Avoid locking knees hard.

name: Bulgarian Split Squat
setup: Place rear foot on a bench and front foot far enough forward for balance.
form_cues: Drop the rear knee toward the floor. Keep front foot planted. Allow front knee to travel naturally over toes.

name: Split Squat
setup: Take a staggered stance with both feet remaining planted.
form_cues: Lower straight down. Keep front foot flat and torso controlled. Push through the front leg.

name: Walking Lunge
setup: Stand tall with space to move forward.
form_cues: Step far enough to stay balanced. Lower rear knee toward floor. Push through the lead foot and continue forward.

name: Reverse Lunge
setup: Stand tall and step one foot backward.
form_cues: Lower until both knees bend comfortably. Keep most pressure through the front foot and return to standing.

name: Step-Up
setup: Use a stable box around knee height or lower.
form_cues: Plant entire working foot on the box. Drive through that leg rather than pushing strongly off the trailing foot.

name: Leg Extension
setup: Align machine knee pivot with your knee joint and pad above ankles.
form_cues: Extend knees smoothly. Squeeze quads at top. Lower under control without slamming the stack.

name: Sissy Squat
setup: Hold a stable support if needed and rise slightly onto the balls of the feet.
form_cues: Let knees travel forward as torso leans back in a straight line. Use a small range at first and stop if knees feel painful.

name: Spanish Squat
setup: Anchor a strong band behind knees and step back until it supports you.
form_cues: Sit back while keeping shins relatively upright. Keep torso tall and drive through the feet.

name: Wall Sit
setup: Slide down a wall until knees are near a comfortable bend.
form_cues: Keep full back supported and feet planted. Hold without letting knees collapse inward.

name: Lying Leg Curl
setup: Align knees with machine pivot and pad just above heels.
form_cues: Curl heels toward glutes without lifting hips from pad. Lower slowly.

name: Seated Leg Curl
setup: Adjust knee pivot and thigh pad snugly.
form_cues: Curl heels down and back. Keep hips against seat and control return.

name: Nordic Hamstring Curl
setup: Secure ankles under a heavy fixed object or with a partner.
form_cues: Keep hips extended and body straight from knees to head. Lower slowly using hamstrings and catch yourself with hands as needed.

name: Single-Leg Romanian Deadlift
setup: Stand on one leg with a soft knee and hold weight in opposite or same hand.
form_cues: Hinge at the hip while rear leg extends behind. Keep hips square and spine neutral.

name: Glute-Ham Raise
setup: Set knees slightly behind the pad and ankles secured.
form_cues: Lower torso under hamstring control while keeping hips extended. Pull back up using hamstrings rather than bending at the waist.

name: Stability Ball Leg Curl
setup: Lie on back with heels on ball and hips lifted.
form_cues: Curl ball toward hips while keeping hips elevated. Extend legs slowly without dropping the pelvis.

name: Slider Leg Curl
equipment: Sliders or towels on smooth floor
setup: Lie on back with heels on sliders and hips raised.
form_cues: Slide heels away and back while keeping hips elevated as much as possible.

name: Good Morning
setup: Set bar across upper back and brace.
form_cues: Push hips backward with knees softly bent. Keep back neutral and stop at a strong hamstring stretch.

name: Barbell Hip Thrust
setup: Upper back rests on a stable bench. Roll padded bar over hips and plant feet around shoulder width.
form_cues: Tuck chin slightly. Drive hips upward until torso is roughly parallel to floor. Finish by squeezing glutes, not overextending low back.

name: Dumbbell Hip Thrust
setup: Place upper back on bench and dumbbell securely across hips.
form_cues: Drive through heels or midfoot. Keep ribs down and squeeze glutes at the top.

name: Glute Bridge
setup: Lie on back with knees bent and feet flat.
form_cues: Drive hips upward while keeping ribs down. Stop when hips are fully extended without arching the back.

name: Single-Leg Glute Bridge
setup: Lie on back with one foot planted and opposite leg raised.
form_cues: Drive through planted foot and keep hips level. Avoid rotating the pelvis.

name: Cable Pull-Through
setup: Set cable low, face away, and straddle rope.
form_cues: Hinge hips back as rope passes between legs. Drive hips forward to stand without leaning back.

name: Cable Kickback
setup: Attach ankle strap to low cable and hold support.
form_cues: Extend leg backward from the hip without arching the low back or rotating the pelvis.

name: Hip Abduction Machine
setup: Sit with pads outside knees and back supported.
form_cues: Press knees outward under control. Avoid bouncing at end range.

name: Banded Lateral Walk
setup: Place mini band above knees or around ankles.
form_cues: Use a slight squat. Step sideways while keeping toes forward and constant band tension.

name: Clamshell
setup: Lie on side with knees bent and hips stacked.
form_cues: Keep feet together while opening top knee. Do not roll pelvis backward.

name: Frog Pump
setup: Lie on back with soles of feet together and knees opened outward.
form_cues: Drive hips up by squeezing glutes. Keep range controlled and ribs down.

name: Standing Calf Raise
setup: Stand on a stable platform with balls of feet supported and heels free.
form_cues: Lower heels under control, then rise as high as possible through the big toe. Avoid bouncing.

name: Seated Calf Raise
setup: Place balls of feet on platform with knees bent and pad over thighs.
form_cues: Lower heels deeply under control, then press up through toes.

name: Single-Leg Calf Raise
setup: Stand on one foot near support.
form_cues: Use full controlled range. Keep ankle from rolling outward and press through the big toe.

name: Donkey Calf Raise
setup: Hinge torso forward with hips supported or use a donkey calf machine.
form_cues: Move only at ankles. Lower heels and rise fully without bouncing.

name: Hip Adduction Machine
setup: Sit with pads inside knees and choose a comfortable starting width.
form_cues: Bring legs together smoothly. Control the return and avoid forcing an extreme stretch.

name: Copenhagen Plank
setup: Lie sideways with top leg supported on a bench and forearm on floor.
form_cues: Lift hips so body is straight. Keep top leg pressing into bench and avoid sagging.

name: Lateral Lunge
setup: Take a wide stance or step far to one side.
form_cues: Sit hips back over the working leg while other leg stays straighter. Keep working foot flat.

name: Plank
setup: Set forearms on floor with elbows under shoulders and legs extended.
form_cues: Squeeze glutes and brace abs. Keep body straight and avoid letting hips sag or pike.

name: Side Plank
setup: Lie on side with elbow under shoulder and legs stacked or staggered.
form_cues: Lift hips until body is straight. Keep chest facing forward and do not rotate downward.

name: Dead Bug
setup: Lie on back with hips and knees at 90 degrees and arms toward ceiling.
form_cues: Press low back gently into floor. Extend opposite arm and leg without losing trunk position.

name: Bird Dog
setup: Start on hands and knees.
form_cues: Extend opposite arm and leg while keeping hips square. Avoid arching or rotating.

name: Hanging Knee Raise
setup: Hang from a bar with shoulders active.
form_cues: Curl pelvis upward as knees rise. Avoid swinging and control the lowering phase.

name: Hanging Leg Raise
setup: Hang from bar with legs straight or slightly bent.
form_cues: Raise legs while curling pelvis upward. Use controlled motion and avoid momentum.

name: Captain's Chair Knee Raise
setup: Support forearms on pads with back against support.
form_cues: Raise knees by curling pelvis. Do not just flex at the hips.

name: Cable Crunch
setup: Kneel facing a high pulley with rope beside the head.
form_cues: Crunch ribs toward pelvis. Keep hips relatively fixed and avoid pulling only with arms.

name: Ab Wheel Rollout
setup: Kneel with wheel under shoulders.
form_cues: Brace and roll forward while keeping hips from sagging. Reverse before losing spinal position.

name: Pallof Press
setup: Stand sideways to an anchored cable or band and hold handle at chest.
form_cues: Press arms forward without letting torso rotate toward the anchor.

name: Russian Twist
setup: Sit with torso leaned back slightly and spine tall.
form_cues: Rotate the ribcage side to side rather than just moving the hands. Keep movement controlled.

name: Bicycle Crunch
setup: Lie on back with hands lightly behind head.
form_cues: Rotate shoulder toward opposite knee while extending the other leg. Do not pull on neck.

name: Reverse Crunch
setup: Lie on back with hips and knees bent.
form_cues: Curl pelvis off the floor by bringing knees toward chest. Avoid swinging legs.

name: Hollow Body Hold
setup: Lie on back and press low back into floor.
form_cues: Lift shoulders and legs while maintaining low-back contact. Bend knees if needed.

name: Mountain Climber
setup: Start in a high plank.
form_cues: Drive knees forward alternately while keeping hips relatively level. Move faster only if trunk stays controlled.

name: Suitcase March
setup: Hold one heavy weight at your side and stand tall.
form_cues: March slowly without leaning. Keep ribs stacked over pelvis.

name: Kettlebell Swing
setup: Set kettlebell a foot or two in front. Hinge and hike it back between legs.
form_cues: Snap hips forward to propel the bell. Arms guide rather than lift. Keep spine neutral and avoid squatting the swing.

name: Dumbbell Thruster
setup: Hold dumbbells at shoulders and stand in squat stance.
form_cues: Squat, then drive upward and use leg momentum to press overhead. Finish with ribs controlled.

name: Barbell Thruster
setup: Hold bar in front rack position.
form_cues: Descend into front squat. Drive up powerfully and transition into an overhead press.

name: Burpee
setup: Stand with room to move.
form_cues: Squat down, place hands, step or jump to plank, perform optional push-up, return feet forward, then stand or jump. Keep landings controlled.

name: Bear Crawl
setup: Start on hands and feet with knees hovering just off the ground.
form_cues: Move opposite hand and foot together. Keep hips low and trunk stable.

name: Sled Push
setup: Load sled and grip handles firmly.
form_cues: Lean forward from ankles, keep spine neutral, and drive short powerful steps through the floor.

name: Sled Pull
setup: Attach strap or grip handles securely.
form_cues: Walk backward or forward depending variation. Keep torso controlled and maintain steady steps.

name: Battle Rope Waves
setup: Anchor ropes securely and hold one end in each hand.
form_cues: Create waves using quick arm motion while maintaining a soft-knee athletic stance and braced torso.

name: Medicine Ball Slam
setup: Use a non-bouncing slam ball in open space.
form_cues: Raise ball overhead without overextending. Slam using trunk and arms, then pick it up with a squat or hinge.

name: Turkish Get-Up
setup: Lie on back holding weight vertically in one hand with same-side knee bent.
form_cues: Keep eyes on the weight initially. Move through elbow, hand, bridge, kneel, then stand. Reverse the sequence slowly. Use light weight until technique is mastered.

name: Power Clean
setup: Start bar over midfoot with a clean grip. Hips above knees and shoulders slightly over bar.
form_cues: Push from floor, keep bar close, then extend hips and knees powerfully. Pull under and catch on shoulders with knees bent. This lift benefits from qualified coaching.

name: Hang Power Clean
setup: Start standing with bar at thighs, then hinge to a hang position above or below knees.
form_cues: Drive through hips and legs, keep bar close, and catch in a partial squat on the shoulders.

name: Clean and Jerk
setup: Perform a clean to the front rack, stand fully, then prepare for the jerk.
form_cues: Dip vertically, drive through legs, and punch under the bar to locked arms. Recover under control. Qualified coaching is strongly recommended.

name: Snatch
setup: Use a wide grip and start bar over midfoot with shoulders over bar.
form_cues: Keep bar close, extend explosively, and pull under into an overhead squat catch. This is highly technical and should be learned with coaching.

name: Hang Power Snatch
setup: Start from a standing hang position with a wide snatch grip.
form_cues: Explode through hips and knees, keep bar close, then pull under to catch overhead in a partial squat.

name: Push Press
setup: Start bar in front rack position.
form_cues: Dip a few inches with torso upright, then drive through legs and press bar overhead.

name: Push Jerk
setup: Start in front rack.
form_cues: Dip and drive upward, then quickly re-bend knees to catch bar overhead before standing fully.

name: Pause Bench Press
setup: Set up like a standard bench press.
form_cues: Lower to chest and pause motionless for about 1 to 2 seconds without relaxing. Press while maintaining tightness.

name: Tempo Squat
setup: Set up like a normal squat.
form_cues: Use a controlled prescribed descent, such as 3 seconds, then stand with normal or prescribed tempo. Keep position consistent.

name: Paused Squat
setup: Use normal squat setup.
form_cues: Pause at the bottom without relaxing or bouncing. Maintain bracing, then drive upward.

name: Block Pull
setup: Set bar on sturdy blocks around mid-shin to knee height.
form_cues: Brace and pull like a deadlift. Keep bar close and avoid overextending at lockout.

name: Rack Pull
setup: Set safety pins at the desired height and place bar on them.
form_cues: Brace before pulling. Stand tall with the bar close. Do not slam the bar onto safeties.

name: Deficit Deadlift
setup: Stand on a stable low platform, usually 1 to 2 inches.
form_cues: Maintain normal deadlift positioning. Use only a deficit that allows a neutral spine and strong start position.

name: Bodyweight Squat
setup: Stand around shoulder width with toes slightly turned out.
form_cues: Sit down between hips. Keep feet flat and knees tracking over toes.

name: Pistol Squat
setup: Stand on one leg with other leg extended forward.
form_cues: Sit down under control while keeping working foot planted. Use support or a box until balance and strength are adequate.

name: Assisted Pistol Squat
setup: Hold a rack, strap, or doorframe lightly for balance.
form_cues: Use the support only as needed. Keep knee tracking over toes and stand through the whole foot.

name: Dips
setup: Support body on parallel bars.
form_cues: Lower under control to a comfortable shoulder depth and press back up without swinging.

name: Muscle-Up
setup: Begin from a strong hang. A strict muscle-up requires a high pull followed by a transition over the bar or rings.
form_cues: Pull explosively with the bar close, transition chest over the support, then press out. Build pull-ups and dips first and avoid uncontrolled kipping when learning.

name: Ring Row
setup: Set rings around waist height and lean back with body straight.
form_cues: Pull rings toward ribs while keeping shoulders down. Adjust foot position to change difficulty.

name: Ring Push-Up
setup: Set rings low and assume push-up position.
form_cues: Keep rings stable and close to body. Lower under control and press while preventing excessive wobble.

name: L-Sit
setup: Support body on straight arms with legs extended forward.
form_cues: Push shoulders down and lift legs using core and hip flexors. Bend knees for an easier variation.

name: Handstand Hold
setup: Kick up against a wall or use a controlled freestanding entry.
form_cues: Push tall through shoulders, squeeze glutes, and keep ribs controlled. Practice in a clear area.

name: Handstand Push-Up
setup: Start in a stable handstand against a wall or freestanding.
form_cues: Lower head between hands while elbows track naturally. Press back to lockout. Use partial range or pike push-ups first.

name: Pike Push-Up
setup: Start in an inverted V with hips high.
form_cues: Lower head toward the floor slightly in front of hands. Keep elbows controlled and press back up.

name: Planche Lean
setup: Start in a push-up position with fingers spread.
form_cues: Lean shoulders forward past wrists while keeping elbows locked and body tight. Use gradual loading to protect wrists.

name: Tuck Front Lever Hold
setup: Hang from a bar and pull shoulders down.
form_cues: Tuck knees toward chest and lift hips until torso approaches horizontal. Keep arms straight and avoid swinging.

name: Skin the Cat
setup: Begin hanging with secure grip.
form_cues: Raise legs and rotate body through the arms into a controlled shoulder stretch, then reverse. Use a small range initially and stop if shoulders feel strained.

name: Treadmill Run
setup: Set speed and incline appropriate to ability. Clip safety key if provided.
form_cues: Run with relaxed shoulders and short natural stride. Land under the body rather than reaching far ahead.

name: Outdoor Run
setup: Choose a safe route and appropriate pace.
form_cues: Keep posture tall and relaxed. Increase distance or intensity gradually.

name: Stationary Bike
setup: Adjust seat so knee remains slightly bent at the bottom of the pedal stroke.
form_cues: Pedal smoothly. Avoid rocking hips side to side.

name: Rowing Machine
setup: Strap feet in and hold handle with straight wrists.
form_cues: Sequence each stroke as legs, body, arms. Return as arms, body, legs. Avoid opening the back too early.

name: Elliptical
setup: Step securely onto pedals and hold handles if needed.
form_cues: Use smooth strides and keep torso upright. Avoid leaning heavily on handles.

name: Stair Climber
setup: Set a manageable speed and lightly hold rails if needed.
form_cues: Stand tall and place most of each foot on the step. Avoid supporting bodyweight through the rails.

name: Jump Rope
setup: Use a rope length that clears the head and feet comfortably.
form_cues: Jump low on the balls of the feet. Turn rope mostly from wrists and keep elbows near sides.

name: High Knees
setup: Stand tall with space to move.
form_cues: Drive knees upward quickly while keeping posture tall and landing softly.

name: Jumping Jacks
setup: Stand upright with arms at sides.
form_cues: Jump feet apart as arms rise overhead, then return. Land softly and maintain rhythm.

name: Box Jump
setup: Use a stable box at a conservative height.
form_cues: Swing arms and jump onto box with both feet. Land softly with knees tracking over toes. Step down rather than jumping down when possible.

name: Broad Jump
setup: Stand with feet around hip width and clear landing space.
form_cues: Load hips and swing arms, then jump forward. Land softly with knees bent and balanced.

name: Skater Jump
setup: Stand on one leg and prepare to jump laterally.
form_cues: Leap side to side, landing softly on one foot. Keep knee aligned with toes and torso controlled.

name: World's Greatest Stretch
setup: Start in a long lunge with hands near the front foot.
form_cues: Rotate the chest toward the front leg and reach upward. Move slowly and do not force range.

name: 90/90 Hip Switch
setup: Sit with both knees bent around 90 degrees, one in front and one to side.
form_cues: Rotate knees from side to side while keeping torso as tall as possible.

name: Couch Stretch
setup: Place one knee near a wall with shin upward and opposite foot in front.
form_cues: Squeeze rear-leg glute and keep ribs down. Increase torso height gradually.

name: Standing Quad Stretch
setup: Stand near support and grasp one ankle behind you.
form_cues: Keep knees close and pelvis neutral. Do not yank the heel toward the glute.

name: Hamstring Stretch
setup: Place heel on a low surface or extend one leg while seated.
form_cues: Hinge from the hips with a neutral back until a gentle stretch is felt.

name: Calf Stretch
setup: Place hands on wall and step one foot back.
form_cues: Keep rear heel down and knee straight for gastrocnemius, or slightly bent for soleus.

name: Doorway Pec Stretch
setup: Place forearm on a doorway with elbow around shoulder height.
form_cues: Step forward gently until chest stretches. Avoid forcing the shoulder backward.

name: Lat Stretch on Bench
setup: Kneel in front of bench and place elbows or hands on it.
form_cues: Sit hips back while dropping chest between arms. Keep ribs controlled.

name: Thoracic Rotation
setup: Start on hands and knees or side-lying.
form_cues: Rotate through the upper back while keeping hips relatively still.

name: Ankle Dorsiflexion Rock
setup: Stand in split stance with front foot flat.
form_cues: Drive front knee over toes while heel stays down. Move in a straight line with knee tracking toes.

name: Band Pull-Apart
setup: Hold a light band at shoulder height with arms straight.
form_cues: Pull band apart by moving shoulder blades back and down. Avoid arching the lower back.

name: Scapular Push-Up
setup: Start in plank with elbows straight.
form_cues: Let shoulder blades move together slightly, then push floor away to spread them apart. Do not bend elbows.

name: Scapular Pull-Up
setup: Hang with elbows straight.
form_cues: Pull shoulders down away from ears to lift body slightly. Keep elbows locked.

name: Face Pull to External Rotation
setup: Set cable around face height.
form_cues: Pull toward face, then rotate hands upward while keeping elbows high but comfortable. Use light weight.

name: Single-Leg Balance
setup: Stand near support on one foot.
form_cues: Keep tripod foot contact and knee softly bent. Progress by reducing support or adding gentle movement.

name: Banded Terminal Knee Extension
setup: Anchor band behind knee and step back so knee begins slightly bent.
form_cues: Straighten knee by contracting quadriceps. Keep foot planted and avoid snapping into hyperextension.

name: Tibialis Raise
setup: Lean back against a wall with heels on floor and feet slightly forward.
form_cues: Lift toes toward shins while heels remain planted. Lower slowly.

name: Heel-Elevated Toe Raise
setup: Stand with heels on a small raised surface and toes free.
form_cues: Lift forefoot toward shins under control. Use support for balance.

name: Hip Airplane
setup: Balance on one leg and hinge forward into a single-leg RDL position.
form_cues: Rotate pelvis open and closed slowly while keeping the stance foot stable. Use support when learning.

name: Neck Flexion
setup: Lie on back with head supported or slightly off edge if appropriate.
form_cues: Gently tuck chin and flex neck through a small controlled range. Use very light resistance.

name: Neck Extension
setup: Lie face down with head supported or use a dedicated neck machine.
form_cues: Extend through a small comfortable range. Avoid jerking or loading heavily.

name: Neck Lateral Flexion
setup: Sit or lie with head neutral.
form_cues: Tilt ear toward shoulder through a controlled range without rotating the head.
